UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Isolated personal stock workspace profile and custom rank configuration for an authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

email.description: Verified account email of the workspace owner.

displayName.description: Display name for the workspace owner.

workspaceName.description: User-defined label for their isolated stock space.

customRanks.description: Bounded list of custom Minecraft rank filters created by the user (max 20 items, each 1..40 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last updated.

MinecraftAccount.title: MinecraftAccount
MinecraftAccount.description: A single Minecraft account inventory record stored in the user's isolated stock space.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this account stock record.

rank.description: Minecraft server or account rank used for quick filtering.

status.description: Current inventory status of the account.

secretKey.description: 2FA TOTP secret key or security key.

capes.description: Bounded list of Minecraft cape names associated with the account (max 30 items, each 1..64 chars).

notes.description: Optional notes on capes, bans, or transfer details.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account record was last updated.

AdminGrant.title: AdminGrant
AdminGrant.description: Trusted admin role assignment granted by the root administrator (iamspyrit@gmail.com).

SuspendedUser.title: SuspendedUser
SuspendedUser.description: Suspension marker preventing non-admin writes on a user's stock space.

/users/{userId}.description: Private workspace document per authenticated user. Isolated to request.auth.uid == userId or verified admin (iamspyrit@gmail.com).

/users/{userId}/accounts/{accountId}.description: Private subcollection storing a user's Minecraft accounts stock. Accessible to owner or verified admin (iamspyrit@gmail.com).

/admins/{userId}.description: Trusted admin grant documents managed strictly by root admin (iamspyrit@gmail.com).

/suspended_users/{userId}.description: Suspended user markers managed strictly by verified admins.
